name: 2xAAA Battery Holder
description: Holds two AAA batteries in series, providing 3.0V nominal (2x 1.5V). The holder is a printed plastic cavity. Three flat metal plates with springs/dome contacts are inserted into channels in the walls. Pin side (+Y) has two small plates (V+ and GND), connector side (-Y) has one wide plate bridging the cells in series. Heavy component — placer should position near bottom of device for balance.

pins.label: Positive tab (3V)
pins.description: Positive tab extension from small plate. 7.5mm long, 0.3mm thick, 3mm wide rectangle passing through floor to ink traces.

pins.label: Ground tab (-)
pins.description: Negative tab extension from small plate. 7.5mm long, 0.3mm thick, 3mm wide rectangle passing through floor to ink traces.

features.label: positive plate channel
features.description: Channel for small V+ plate (13.03mm wide, 1.46mm thick, 13.1mm tall).

features.label: negative plate channel
features.description: Channel for small GND plate (13.03mm wide, 1.46mm thick, 13.1mm tall).

features.label: inter-cell contact plate channel
features.description: Channel for wide connector plate (27.2mm wide, 1.46mm thick). Depth matches full cavity height so the channel is open at the top during component insert pause, allowing the plate to slide in from above.

features.label: V+ dome contact window
features.description: Window for 7.5mm dome contact on V+ plate to reach battery.

features.label: GND dome contact window
features.description: Window for 7.5mm dome contact on GND plate to reach battery.

features.label: inter-cell dome contact window
features.description: Single merged window for both 7.5mm domes on wide plate. 21.6mm wide clears side-wall overhang and cell divider. Full cavity depth so it is open at pause.

features.label: V+ pin passthrough
features.description: Floor slot for V+ plate tab extension to reach ink traces.

features.label: GND pin passthrough
features.description: Floor slot for GND plate tab extension to reach ink traces.
